statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
The service is needed to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods
The study will assist in confirming the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91)
The study will guide appropriate rate or rhythm control management
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
